## What happened

Describe the observed behavior and the expected behavior.

## Minimal reproduction

List only the non-sensitive steps, ThreadCells version, and local environment details needed to reproduce.

## Evidence

Attach redacted logs or screenshots if useful. Do not include credentials, private paths, state databases, terminal transcripts, or security vulnerabilities.

## Scope check

- [ ] I confirmed this is not a request to expose a loopback-only service.
- [ ] I removed sensitive and personal data.
- [ ] I read `SECURITY.md` for security-reporting boundaries.
